sources: https://www.campspot.com/book/glacierpeaks-mt (Campspot park record and availability API, 2 adults, 1 night from 2026-10-27, 2027-06-15 and 2027-06-19)

values.note: Campspot quotes for one night, 2 adults, before tax (Campspot's per-night figure includes any park or booking fee): summer 2027 (Tue June 15 and Sat June 19 alike) $73.45 for a 30-amp water/electric site, $83.75 full hookup; late October 2026 $71.39 and $76.80.

fees.source: https://www.campspot.com/api/gator-core/v2/availability/parks/4742?checkin=2027-06-15&checkout=2027-06-16&guests=guests0,2,0 ('Back-in 30amp/Water Only' and 'Pull-Through 30amp/Water Only' averagePricePerNight 73.45; full-hookup types 83.75; same for 2027-06-19; 2026-10-27: 71.39 / 76.80), read 2026-10-21

hookups.source: https://glacierpeaksrvpark.com/rv-spaces/ ('30 & 50-amp hookups, water and sewer connections, cable TV') + Campspot site types ('50amp Pull-Through Full Hookup RV Site', 'Pull-Through 30 Amp FHU'), read 2026-10-21

values.note: 60 RV spaces per the operator; 38 RV sites bookable on Campspot (32 pull-through, 6 back-in water/electric), each listing RVs up to 42 ft. The operator says rigs 'up to 40 feet in length (or larger!)'.

sites.source: https://glacierpeaksrvpark.com/ ('60 spacious RV spaces') + https://glacierpeaksrvpark.com/rv-spaces/ ('Large Pull-Through Sites Available', 'up to 40 feet in length (or larger!)') + Campspot campsites rvInfo ('rvLengthMax': 42), read 2026-10-21

facilities.source: https://glacierpeaksrvpark.com/rv-spaces/ ('full-service restrooms featuring shower facilities', 'convenient laundry facilities', 'Cable & WiFi Available'), read 2026-10-21

values.note: Non-refundable 20% deposit at booking; the balance is charged 7 days before arrival. Check-in 1 p.m., check-out 11 a.m. No refunds for early departure.

booking.source: https://www.campspot.com/book/glacierpeaks-mt (park policies: 'all reservations are charged a non-refundable deposit equal to 20%', 'Check-in time is 1:00pm and check-out time is 11:00am for RV sites'), read 2026-10-21

note: RV park on MT-40 between Columbia Falls and Whitefish; sites among evergreens with peek-a-boo mountain views. --Claude
summary: Confirmed on the operator's site and Campspot: reservable on Campspot, 30/50-amp full hookups and 30-amp water/electric, showers/laundry/WiFi. Added fees $73.45-83.75 (summer 2027, before tax), 60 spaces (38 online) to 42 ft with pull-throughs. Not stated: season, discounts. The rules page answers a hosting block page.
flags: Price gate lifted: Glacier National Park gateway (23.9 km from an entrance, gateways.py; West Glacier). Base $73.45/night summer 2027 is over US$50. The family has not stayed here.

https://glacierpeaksrvpark.com/rules-regulations/ returns a hosting block page ('Website owner? If you think you have reached this message in error, please contact support'); the rest of the site works.
